findings.concern: A future consumer could compare briefs whose input scopes are different.
findings.resolution: Expose the exact already-parsed mode, range and changed-file/line map as versioned JSON provenance.

findings.concern: A deletion-only path has no surviving new-file line and could be confused with a whole-file selection.
findings.resolution: Serialize it as an explicit empty integer list; reserve the string whole for --files only.

findings.concern: Path or line ordering could make reports noisy across equivalent invocations.
findings.resolution: Use the diff map's ordered bindings and sort line numbers before JSON serialization.

findings.concern: Provenance might accidentally strengthen the existing reachability claim.
findings.resolution: Keep text/Markdown output and analysis semantics untouched; existing tests retain the possible_bounded/TOP controls.

open: A later runner must validate an explicit scope manifest before comparing two impact briefs.
